B.signatureMoment: Slide 5: the readiness table places evidence, consequence, and status in one useful reference view, with reporting and acceptance-testing failures clearly distinguished.

result.reason: I would give the user A only after mandatory reflow; as rendered, neither deck is ready. Both satisfy the ten-slide format and use professional palettes, and both responsibly flag synthetic facts, but both fail the hard readability and coverage gate because required material is clipped. A has the stronger brief-specific system: its field-guide rail, tactile process imagery, service sequence, decision focal panel, status evidence, and cross-linked risk identifiers provide more useful navigation and storytelling than B's largely table-driven editorial treatment. B's most serious omission is slide 9, where the promised open questions have no visible content. The principal generation defect in both decks is failed pagination and overflow. The principal selection/design defect in B is reliance on a generic cover image and prose tables instead of explanatory synthesis; in A it is trying to fit too many substantive sections beneath image-led compositions. Route identity is unavailable, so the 'original arm' cannot be identified; the more visually complex observed arm, A, does earn some of that complexity through better hierarchy and memorable focal slides, but not enough to overcome its readiness failure. Reversing presentation order would not change the preference. A exceeds competent default quality in isolated moments, especially slide 6, but not as a complete rendered deliverable. The single most important improvement for B is to repaginate it so every required section is fully visible, especially boundaries, definition of done, open questions, and T+30.
result.whatWouldMakeWinnerExceptional: Repaginate A into a fully readable deck and replace the overloaded slide 9 with one integrated launch-confidence map that visibly connects the active issue to its risk, decision, evidence owner, open questions, and dated next action. Carry that clarity through a fully visible T+30 ending.
